decision_register.statement: CSS Modules only; native basic controls and Radix complex primitives; explicit Zustand sole app/domain state store; bounded fresh reads without Query/XState; pnpm/Nx retained.
decision_register.source: User explicitly delegates fit-for-purpose selection and prohibits same-responsibility duplication; Astra/high proposal grounded in actual dependencies.
decision_register.impact: Incremental library changes after compatible versions and contracts checked
decision_register.resolution: Replace custom canonical external store with window-scoped Zustand; assistant-ui gets derived projection. No same-value duplicated store/cache.

decision_register.statement: No competing app libraries/stores/caches for the same responsibility.
decision_register.impact: Dependency decisions require ownership and replacement rationale.
decision_register.resolution: CSS Modules only; Nx only task orchestrator; one projection and one read owner per resource; upstream internals disclosed.

decision_register.statement: Explicitly adopt Zustand for app-wide and domain-specific state outside assistant-ui.
decision_register.source: Latest user correction: upstream assistant-ui Zustand does not obviate app state needs.
decision_register.impact: Changes app-domain owner mechanism, preserves main authority and one owner per value.
decision_register.resolution: Window-scoped vanilla Zustand store with pure domain transitions; no custom competing canonical store; direct version alignment and compatibility probe required.
